value_head_norm_calibration.statistic: per-layer, per-output-head median across analyzed tokens
value_head_norm_calibration.delta_value_site: after causal convolution and activation; before memory update
value_head_norm_calibration.full_attention_value_site: projected value (normalized value for Gemma4), before attention weighting
value_head_norm_calibration.grouped_query: shared KV values projected separately through each query head output map
value_head_norm_calibration.dtype: float32 projection and norm from captured model-dtype values
value_head_norm_calibration.score: current projected value norm / this head's value scale

head_norm_calibration.statistic: per-layer, per-output-head median across analyzed tokens (query heads for full attention; value heads for DeltaNet)
head_norm_calibration.dtype: float32 projection and norm from captured model-dtype activations

statistic: median across analyzed tokens of token p99(abs(activation) * l2_norm(output-projection direction))
side_definition: sign of the activation-weighted contribution magnitude nearest p99 at the token supplying the layer median
